name: Pavel Moreau
headline: Senior Mobile Engineer
summary: Mobile engineer focused on building and improving customer-facing apps across product teams. Experienced in delivering reliable features, tightening release processes, and working closely with design and backend partners. Strong background in cross-platform mobile work, code quality, and shipping iterative improvements.

bullets: Built early app features in Java and Kotlin, and used React Native to keep shared mobile flows consistent.
Wrote Jest checks for new screens and reduced regressions in the junior team by 30%.
Fixed UI defects and polished onboarding behavior in React Native, improving completion rates by 12%.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Shipped mobile features in Dart and Java, coordinating with product owners on weekly release goals.

Improved local validation and code review habits across the team, raising merge quality for the main app.

roles.title: Mobile Engineer
bullets: Delivered app updates in Dart and Java while maintaining shared business logic across mobile releases.

roles.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
bullets: Led release planning and delivery using CI/CD and Git, helping the team ship 40% more frequently.
